name: Statement
label: Statement
description: A financial statement: titled sections of amounts with totals, and subtotals down to a bottom line, a column per period.

props.name: periods
props.description: The periods the amounts are for, the column headers in order ("Q1", "Q2", "Year to date").

props.name: items
props.description: The sections and subtotals, top to bottom; the last subtotal is the bottom line.

props.name: currency
props.description: The ISO 4217 code the amounts are in. Defaults to `USD`.

props.name: caption
props.description: The statement's name, read as the table's caption ("Profit and loss, 2026").

props.name: captionVisible
props.description: Shows the caption above the table; it is read either way.

props.name: labelHeader
props.description: The header of the label column. Defaults to "Item".

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the amounts are written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.

props.name: size
props.description: Row density: `compact` for a statement in a side panel.

DecimalString.description: A decimal amount written with an optional leading minus, digits and an optional `.` fraction: `"1234.50"`, `"-0.07"`.

StatementLine.description: One line of a section: what it is, and its amount in each period.

StatementSection.description: A titled group of lines, with an optional total under them.

StatementSubtotal.description: A running total of every section above it, each counted by its sign: a gross profit, a net profit.

alternatives.name: Table
alternatives.when: the rows are records to read rather than sections of amounts that add up
